title: Origin story: Wildemere
description: Wildemere was the lake itself, given a woman's shape when a drowned village's grief proved too heavy for still water. She remembers every year the lake has seen — the droughts, the drownings, the weddings on the shore. She walks the shoreline at dawn, and those who meet her remember their own lives more clearly.
